# BRAND NAME

> One sentence: who, what, for whom. Example: "Sample Studio is Anna Sample's photography business. She photographs weddings and corporate portraits in northern Germany."

Two to three paragraphs of fact sentences. One fact per sentence, no advertising language. Who is behind it, location, service area, training, verifiable experience (with source), reach.
